label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is a false positive because the sink value is sanitized via ESAPI.encodeForHTML(bar) before writing to the response writer, rendering the output safe. Alert 2 (java/xml/xpath-injection) is a true positive because the variable 'bar', derived from user input 'param' (verified by conditional logic (7*42)-106 > 200 evaluating to false, thus bar=param), flows unsanitized into the XPath expression at line 67.

evidence.note: XSS sink uses encodeForHTML(bar) which sanitizes user input before HTML output, mitigating the vulnerability.
XPath injection sink uses 'bar' directly. Conditional logic ((7*42)-106 > 200) resolves to false, making 'bar' equal to user input 'param', allowing injection.
